correctness.rationale: For m=2e and F/K quadratic, x^(2^e+1)=N(x) in K; trace transitivity reduces both binary trace constraints to Tr_K(c_i N(x))=0 with c_i=a_i+a_i^(2^e), hence D=N^(-1)(C^perp\{0}). Surjective norm has fibers size 2^e+1, giving |D|=(2^(e-r)-1)(2^e+1). If C′=sC then C′^perp=s^(-1) C^perp, choose t with N(t)=s^(-1); multiplication by t bijects defining sets and reparameterizes b in the trace code, proving permutation equivalence. The cyclic norm-one kernel of order 2^e+1 acts freely on D. The three source Theorem 3.5 regimes have rank r=1. Independently checked GF64 trace transitivity for all 64*8 input pairs and all 7 nonzero relative-trace scalar normalizations with norm-one invariance; infinite conclusion follows from algebra.
